notes: The supplied text (catalog pp. 209-210) contains only the Sustainable Agriculture (AS) degree section, between Civil & Surveying Technology and SWHS: Addiction Studies (AA). No Sustainable Agriculture Certificate of Achievement section is printed, so no blocks, total, outcomes or careers were recorded for the certificate.

For reviewer reference, the AS section lists: required AGME 50 (3), AGRI 20 (4), AGRI 30 (3), AGRI 70 (3), SUAG 5 (3), SUAG 160 (3), SUAG 109 (4); select at least 4 units from AGRI 56, AGRI 98, ANSC 153, SUAG 56, SUAG 64, SUAG 65, SUAG 103, SUAG 116, SUAG 117, SUAG 119, SUAG 120, SUAG 153; LIR 10 (1); Total Hours/Units 28. AGME 50, SUAG 153 and LIR 10 are not on the closed list. SUAG 160 is printed as 3 units while the state file stores 2.

The AS section names job titles (farming, agricultural production, market gardener, farm manager, propagator, crop consultant, organic inspectors, farm advisor, agricultural supplier, compost production and sales) and prints four program student learning outcomes; these belong to the AS section and were not recorded for the certificate.
The certificate section is likely on another catalog page; check the source PDF near page 210 or the certificate listings.
